title: Stay on the Sunny Side
transcription:
Stay on the Sunny Side

Stay on the sunny side, always on the
sunny side,
Stay on the sunny side of life (two!
Three! Four!)
You'll feel no pain, as we drive you
insane,
If you stay on the sunny side of life.

'Knock-knock!' (who's there?)
'Warren,'
(warren who?) 'Warren Peace!' (ahhh-
hhh!)

Repeat song as many times as desired, with
volunteers from the staff or audience doing
their own knock-knock joke and the group
answering.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from a clear two-page scan. Several nonsense/phonetic words are uncertain.
